headline: Your Software Vendor Could Sue You For Leaving—Just Ask Allstate
reasoning: This story excels in clickability and format diversity by framing a complex B2B lawsuit as a relatable 'messy breakup' with high stakes, tapping into widespread frustration with big tech. While not a hands-on tool, it provides immense practical value as a cautionary tale for any business or professional, highlighting the hidden risks of vendor lock-in. The involvement of a household name like Allstate gives it strong mainstream appeal, making it a perfect fit for our audience.
summary: Insurance giant Allstate is being sued by Broadcom after deciding to stop using its VMware software, in what Allstate alleges is a retaliatory move. The lawsuit highlights the increasingly aggressive tactics customers face when trying to leave major software ecosystems.

source_articles.title: Allstate accuses Broadcom of auditing it because it quit VMware, CA
source_articles.excerpt: Broadcom accuses Allstate of dodging VMware audits.
